title: Flow numbers: attempts an hour, first-pass yield, wait per station and a slow-station line, on Work and in master status
description: The real control plane reads four attempts ended in the last 24 hours, one sent back by the merge trial, and an item waiting 2 hours in review from the ledger: /api/flow carries 75% first-pass yield and the review station's wait for 6 hours, 24 hours and 7 days, and master status carries the same numbers with one attention line naming review and its oldest item. A real browser on the built dashboard at 1280 and 390 px shows merges an hour, attempts an hour and '75%' first pass in the Work page header, the slow-station line, and a fold opening each station's median and slowest-tenth wait and the rework causes with counts, with no sideways scroll.
